row.evidence: Cloudflare's docs say "Cloudflare dashboard SCIM provisioning is only available to Enterprise customers using Okta, Microsoft Entra, or Authentik", while dashboard SSO "is available for free to all plans".
row.notes: New row. Scored on the Cloudflare dashboard (account members). Application-services plans are flat per domain, not per user: Free $0, Pro $20/mo annual ($25 monthly), Business $200/mo annual ($250 monthly), Enterprise (shown as Contract, custom, billed annually); the SCIM doc says Enterprise, the pricing page now labels that tier Contract. Dashboard SSO (via a Zero Trust IdP connector) is free on all plans. SCIM uses an account API token with SCIM Provisioning Edit; Okta is set up with the generic SCIM 2.0 Test App and Entra with a non-gallery app (Authentik also documented). SCIM creates members with Minimal Account Access, pushes User Groups that carry permission policies, and removes the account membership on active:false; profile attribute updates are not supported. Separately, Cloudflare Zero Trust has its own SCIM for any SCIM 2.0 IdP on all Zero Trust plans (Free up to 50 users, $7/user/mo pay-as-you-go), but it only deprovisions and syncs groups; it does not create users. Members, user groups and audit-log APIs are on all plans.

auth.token_source: Cloudflare API token (account-owned recommended) with Account > SCIM Provisioning > Edit

operations.notes: PATCH/PUT are used to send active:false (removes the account membership); profile attribute updates (firstName, lastName, email) are not applied, and Okta's Update User Attributes is unsupported, so row.scim_ops.update is false.

deprovision.notes: Unassigning the user removes them as an account member; removing a user from all role groups leaves them a member with Minimal Account Access. Seats do not apply to per-domain plans.

attributes.notes: Attribute names as written in Cloudflare's docs; no SCIM schema or attribute list is published. Group attributes inferred from Push Groups only, so group list is the minimum; Entra requires UPN and email to match.

roles.how: Pushed IdP groups become Cloudflare User Groups; permission policies (roles and scopes) are attached to the group in Cloudflare. Legacy CF-<accountID>-<Role> Virtual Groups are deprecated.

limitations.text: Only Okta, Microsoft Entra and Authentik are supported IdPs.
User profile fields (firstName, lastName, email) are set only at initial provisioning; email-domain changes are rejected.
The sole Super Administrator on an Enterprise account is not deprovisioned; misconfigured groups can remove all Super Administrators.
SCIM group names cannot begin with CF; SCIM-managed User Groups cannot be edited in the dashboard or API.
Removing a user from a SCIM group does not remove account membership; only active:false does.

capabilities.notes: Add Member invites an email to the account (Enterprise can skip email confirmation for existing Cloudflare users); Remove Member revokes access. Cloudflare user profiles are owned by the user, not the account.

endpoints.purpose: List roles (deprecated in favour of iam/permission_groups)

rate_limits.text: 1,200 requests per five minutes per user (global Client API limit); members list max 50 per page.

okta.notes: The OIN 'Cloudflare' app (last updated 2018) has only SWA checked. Cloudflare's own guide provisions through Okta's generic SCIM 2.0 Test App, so row.idp.okta is via_generic. built_by not stated on the page; idp assumed for an SWA template.

entra.notes: No gallery app (cloudflare-tutorial 404); Cloudflare documents a non-gallery Entra app pointed at the SCIM endpoint.

fallbacks.other_sync: Cloudflare Zero Trust SCIM (separate integration, any SCIM 2.0 IdP) deprovisions Zero Trust users and syncs groups for Access/Gateway policies, but does not create dashboard members.

open_questions: Cloudflare does not publish its SCIM schema: supported filters, pagination, ServiceProviderConfig/Schemas endpoints and the exact attribute names are undocumented.
Whether SCIM deprovisioning ends active dashboard sessions is not stated.
Whether SCIM DELETE /Users is supported (vs active:false) is not stated.
Google Workspace, OneLogin and JumpCloud dashboard SCIM are not documented (only Okta, Entra, Authentik).
